authoring.author: claude (kinkerstraat even-side faces lane)
authoring.note: Kinkerstraat 116-112 (even side, 1895), 2024-12-11 strip; a bus hides the ground of 116. Plain red brick, flat-headed windows under brick relieving arches on storeys 1-3, flat top storey (kinker-1890-plain-brick with a relieving head by eye; the cluster gave kinker-1890-brick-arched, NCC 0.42/0.37, but there are no white blocks). 112-114 ends in a narrow bay of moulded brick ornament the kit cannot say.
